EmailTemplate.name: AHIP / FFM Certification Expiry Alert
EmailTemplate.subject: AHIP / FFM Certification Expiry Alert
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
``` AHIP / FFM Certification Expiry Alert Dear {!Recipient.Name}, This is a reminder that your AHIP / FFM certification is approaching expiration.
Certification Name {!Certification__c.Name} Certification Type {!Certification__c.Certification_Type__c} Status {!Certification__c.Status__c} Days Remaining {!Certification__c.Days_Until_Expiry__c} Days
Please complete your renewal before the expiration date to avoid interruption in compliance or appointment eligibility. If you have already renewed your certification, please disregard this message. Thank you, Compliance Team ```
